overview.text: This is the Mist-Fit 550, fully assembled: 220 parts, put together in 69 steps. Press Next step to see the parts kit.

parts-kit.text: Here is the parts kit. Each component is shown along its removal direction. Press Next step to begin with step 1.

step-01.text: Step 1. Start the gauge box enclosure sub-assembly. Place the gauge box enclosure.

step-02.text: Step 2. Fit the gauge mounting panel to the gauge box enclosure.

step-03.text: Step 3. Fit six pan head machine screws to the gauge box enclosure, from above.

step-04.text: Step 4. Start the unit body sub-assembly. Place the unit body.

step-05.text: Step 5. Fit the back panel to the unit body, from below.

step-06.text: Step 6. Fit two track mount legs to the unit body.

step-07.text: Step 7. Fit the filter element track to the unit body, from above.

step-08.text: Step 8. Fit the bellmouth support track to the unit body, from above.

step-09.text: Step 9. Fit two clip nuts to the unit body, from below. This is the first of two sets.

step-10.text: Step 10. Fit the filter base to the unit body, from above.

step-11.text: Step 11. Fit the completed gauge box enclosure sub-assembly to the unit body, from above.

step-12.text: Step 12. Fit the spring nut angle to the unit body.

step-13.text: Step 13. Fit four self-tapping pan head screws to the unit body.

step-14.text: Step 14. Fit two clip nuts to the unit body. This is the second of two sets.

step-15.text: Step 15. Fit two impeller bracket supports to the unit body, from below.

step-16.text: Step 16. Fit the gauge box cover to the unit body.

step-17.text: Step 17. Start the access door sub-assembly. Place the door frame.

step-18.text: Step 18. Fit the access door to the door frame.

step-19.text: Step 19. Fit six closed-end rivets to the door frame.

step-20.text: Step 20. Start the unit body assembly. Place the unit body sub-assembly.

step-21.text: Step 21. Fit the first of two filter clamp bolt brackets to the unit body sub-assembly.

step-22.text: Step 22. Fit the completed access door sub-assembly to the unit body sub-assembly.

step-23.text: Step 23. Fit the impeller guard to the unit body sub-assembly, from above.

step-24.text: Step 24. Fit the filter clamp to the unit body sub-assembly, from above.

step-25.text: Step 25. Fit the second of two filter clamp bolt brackets to the unit body sub-assembly.

step-26.text: Step 26. Start the filter frame half sub-assembly. Place the filter frame half. Repeat this on both filter frame half sub-assemblies.

step-27.text: Step 27. Fit the second filter frame half to the first. Repeat this on both filter frame half sub-assemblies.

step-28.text: Step 28. Fit four blind rivets to the filter frame half. This is the first of two sets. Repeat this on both filter frame half sub-assemblies.

step-29.text: Step 29. Fit four filter retaining bars to the filter frame half. Repeat this on both filter frame half sub-assemblies.

step-30.text: Step 30. Fit eight blind rivets to the filter frame half. This is the second of two sets. Repeat this on both filter frame half sub-assemblies.

step-31.text: Step 31. Start the mesh filter media sub-assembly. Place the filter frame half sub-assembly.

step-32.text: Step 32. Fit four blind rivets to the filter frame half sub-assembly.

step-33.text: Step 33. Fit the mesh filter media to the filter frame half sub-assembly.

step-34.text: Step 34. Start the perforated filter baffle sub-assembly. Place the filter frame half sub-assembly.

step-35.text: Step 35. Fit the first of three perforated filter baffles to the filter frame half sub-assembly.

step-36.text: Step 36. Fit the second of three perforated filter baffles to the filter frame half sub-assembly.

step-37.text: Step 37. Fit the third of three perforated filter baffles to the filter frame half sub-assembly.

step-38.text: Step 38. Start the impeller drive motor assembly. Place the impeller drive motor unit.

step-39.text: Step 39. Fit the motor mounting bracket to the impeller drive motor unit, from above.

step-40.text: Step 40. Fit four motor mounting hex bolts to the impeller drive motor unit, from above.

step-41.text: Step 41. Fit four external tooth lock washers to the impeller drive motor unit, from above.

step-42.text: Step 42. Fit the bellmouth mounting plate to the impeller drive motor unit, from above.

step-43.text: Step 43. Fit six hex flange bolts to the impeller drive motor unit, from below.

step-44.text: Step 44. Fit six hex flange nuts to the impeller drive motor unit, from above.

step-45.text: Step 45. Start the pleated filter housing half sub-assembly. Place the pleated filter housing half.

step-46.text: Step 46. Fit the second pleated filter housing half to the first.

step-47.text: Step 47. Fit ten blind rivets to the pleated filter housing half.

step-48.text: Step 48. Start the pleated filter element sub-assembly. Place the pleated filter housing half sub-assembly.

step-49.text: Step 49. Fit the pleated filter element to the pleated filter housing half sub-assembly.

step-50.text: Step 50. Fit the filter gasket to the pleated filter housing half sub-assembly, from below.

step-51.text: Step 51. Start the final assembly. Place the unit body assembly.

step-52.text: Step 52. Fit the cable strain relief to the unit body assembly.

step-53.text: Step 53. Fit five hex flange bolts to the unit body assembly, from above. This is the first of two sets.

step-54.text: Step 54. Fit eight self-tapping pan head screws to the unit body assembly, from below.

step-55.text: Step 55. Fit two filter clamp hex bolts to the unit body assembly, from below.

step-56.text: Step 56. Fit thirty-eight closed-end rivets to the unit body assembly.

step-57.text: Step 57. Fit eight pan head machine screws to the unit body assembly.

step-58.text: Step 58. Fit the strain relief nut to the unit body assembly.

step-59.text: Step 59. Fit four door bolt washers to the unit body assembly.

step-60.text: Step 60. Fit the pressure gauge to the unit body assembly.

step-61.text: Step 61. Fit two hex nuts to the unit body assembly, from above.

step-62.text: Step 62. Fit two filter clamp knobs to the unit body assembly, from above.

step-63.text: Step 63. Fit ten clip nuts to the unit body assembly, from below. This is the first of two sets.

step-64.text: Step 64. Fit the completed mesh filter media sub-assembly to the unit body assembly.

step-65.text: Step 65. Fit the completed perforated filter baffle sub-assembly to the unit body assembly.

step-66.text: Step 66. Fit the completed impeller drive motor assembly to the unit body assembly, from above.

step-67.text: Step 67. Fit three hex flange bolts to the unit body assembly, from above. This is the second of two sets.

step-68.text: Step 68. Fit four clip nuts to the unit body assembly. This is the second of two sets.

step-69.text: Step 69. Fit the completed pleated filter element sub-assembly to the unit body assembly, from above. The assembly is complete.

complete.text: The Mist-Fit 550 assembly is complete. All 220 components are in their final positions.
